directChecks.check: 26 probe pads versus every foreign-net top trace span, segment distance minus widths/radius, source connectivity-key comparison

result.method: Point-to-segment distance minus TP radius and maximum adjacent route widths / 2; excludes exact connectivity-key equality. No pads, vias, pours or mask geometry in this check.

directChecks.check: Ground-pad center proximity and named actual copper path length

directChecks.result: All 18 signal probes lie outside fitted footprint bounding boxes. The tightest signal-pad envelope edge margin is TP11 to R202: 0.448175697 mm. This is not a 3D accessibility guarantee.

strengths: Eight LEDs form a readable common status area; 18 signal pads and eight ground pads cover input, protected input, logic power, fan power, Peltier output, filtered analog channels, I2C, DAC, reset, buffered permission states and tachometer.
All probes use 1.5 mm exposed top copper with no fitted part, which is practical for DMM tips or pogo fixtures.
Rail LED resistors are next to their source rail pickups; long indicator paths are downstream of current-limiting resistors, avoiding distribution of an unrestricted power rail to the status cluster.

Status indicators and status test points use Schmitt-buffered copies of control states. Filtered ADC test points attach downstream of the filters. These avoid direct LED loading of the actual safety/control inputs.
Power probe/ground pairs TP02, TP03 and TP04 have 2.83, 2.92 and 2.50 mm center spacing, respectively.
The scoped 26-pad versus foreign top trace sweep finds zero overlaps and a minimum copper edge gap above the configured 0.2 mm trace-to-pad rule.

findings.explanation: Measured: ground reference access is uneven. HOT/COLD ADC test pads are 13.7 and 10.7 mm from the nearest ground test pad; I2C test pads are 10.595 and 12.470 mm away. Inference: DMM and slow level checks remain practical, but a spring-ground scope probe cannot form a very short loop at several of the channels most likely to need noise/edge diagnosis.
findings.evidence: rating_debug_access_measurements.json signalProbes TP06, TP07, TP10, TP11; nearest ground center distances

findings.explanation: Measured: the five rail LED series paths consume 273.676 mm of signal routing; FAN12 alone is 93.693 mm and TEC+ is 77.375 mm. Inference: the common status cluster improves human usability but creates long cross-board branches, via transfers and corridor occupancy. This does not establish an electrical failure; these branches are resistor-limited and carry indicator current.
findings.evidence: routeGroups D501_SERIES through D505_SERIES in rating_debug_access_measurements.json; D504 pcb_trace_141/142/143; D505 pcb_trace_146/147/148; src/blocks/debug.tsx railSeriesPaths

findings.explanation: Measured: TP07, TP08 and TP09 are only 2.8 mm directly from their filter capacitor pickup pads but use 11.704, 11.791 and 12.486 mm of routed surface branch, respectively, each with two full-through barrels. Inference: a revised local probe arrangement could reduce parasitic stub area and remove avoidable via/corridor congestion, subject to checking the existing power and feedback routes. No analog error is established by this geometry alone.
findings.evidence: routeGroups TP07_FILTERED through TP09_FILTERED in rating_debug_access_measurements.json; src/blocks/debug.tsx filteredProbePaths. Actual surface trace lengths exclude barrel depth.

findings.explanation: Measured: TPG5 has only 0.249995 mm copper-edge spacing to the 3 mm wide TEC_OUTPUT_TERMINAL route. This satisfies the configured 0.2 mm trace-to-pad clearance; it is not a clearance violation or a confirmed short. Inference: a grounded probe landing has little geometric margin beside output copper if either is exposed by the final mask or accidentally scraped. Finished mask exposure was not checked.
findings.evidence: rating_debug_access_measurements.json groundProbes TPG5 nearestForeignTopTrace; pcb_trace_58 segment [35,-2.499995] to [44,-2.499995]

suspectedShortAssessment.status: No confirmed short in this agent’s debug/probe scoped check; the user crop is not localized by this review.
suspectedShortAssessment.scope: Only test-pad circles versus top-layer trace spans. Does not exclude shorts elsewhere, or probe interactions with pads, vias, pours, mask openings or actual solder.

topImprovements: Add or move short-loop ground pads beside the left ADC pair and I2C test pads. Prioritize a 2–3 mm center spacing where geometry permits.
Reconsider the ADC probe row location to attach nearer the filter output without the 11–12.5 mm detours and two barrels; retain downstream filter topology.
If a next layout prioritizes compact copper, move FAN12/TEC+ indicators closer to their rails or dedicate a simple peripheral indicator corridor while keeping current limiting at the rail origin.
Move TPG5 farther from the wide TEC output copper if its final probe landing and mask openings permit, then rerun clearance and ground-connectedness checks.
limitations: This is a static routing/serviceability rating, not manufacturing or bench acceptance.
No full-board short detector was run by this role; other roles must investigate the attached crop and copper pours.
Axis-aligned PCB component bounding boxes are footprint envelopes, not detailed fitted 3D bodies or courtyard certification.
No measurement of analog noise, I2C capacitance, LED brightness, or oscilloscope behavior was performed.
Minimum pad-to-foreign-trace gap is copper geometry, not a finished solder-mask exposure or solder-bridge assessment.
